purpose: Identify scientifically defensible routes from artificial-light source data to target-direction sky radiance without treating a zenith atlas, VIIRS-DNB radiance, a two-scattering-order solver, or a fitted residual as a validated high-accuracy directional provider.

requiredPredictionQuantity.minimumResearchChannel: Johnson-Cousins V or an explicitly calibrated equivalent response
